name: Church and Dominican Convent of Santa Maria delle Grazie with “The Last Supper” by Leonardo da Vinci
description: In the heart of Milan, this Dominican convent and church began rising in 1463, and Bramante reworked parts of it near the end of the 15th century. Its star attraction is in the dining hall, or refectory: Leonardo da Vinci's enormous Last Supper, painted on the north wall between 1495 and 1497. Visitors file in to see the moment Christ's apostles react to his words.
